steps.what: Floor 2: rims, then joists on the burned layout; blocking.
Ridge, rafters pair by pair (labels R01-02-xx left and right), ceiling joists tie the walls.
steps.app: Scan rafter: seat at 463 mm from low end

benefits.value: 3.6 h saved on floors and roof (about CAD 166)
benefits.detail: Same model as Wall framing, 24% of the pieces. Angled rafter cuts take longer than square cuts on site, so this is conservative.

benefits.value: 8 steps flagged for fall protection, no cutting at the eave
benefits.detail: Every rafter arrives cut and marked, so no saw work happens on the roof (WorkSafeBC Part 11 fall protection still applies).

benefits.value: 5.6% cut waste vs 10% typical order allowance
benefits.detail: Acucut 1D nester on this trade's 119 sticks: 96 boards, 502.31 m stock for 474.36 m of parts (bundle-window constrained runs add about 0.5 points). Conventional allowance 5 to 15% (BuildingScience). Difference about 98 bf, CAD 69 at CAD 700/MBF (estimate).

FMI puts rework at about 5% of construction spend and 48% of rework on poor communication or data. If labelled, sequenced, pre-checked parts prevent 15 to 30% of this trade's rework (estimate), callbacks fall by 0.75 to 1.50% of trade spend.

cell_does: Cuts 44 rafters with both plumb cuts (30.5 deg) and burns the birdsmouth seat line at the wall line.
Cuts floor and ceiling joists to model length and rims to the perimeter; marks bearing and hanger positions.
Bundles by level: floor 2 joists before the roof so the crane lift order matches the build order.
cell_cannot: Cut the birdsmouth notch itself (a compound notch): it is marked; the framer cuts it, or a notching head add-on does.
Build trusses: the run used stick framing (trusses: 0).

addons.name: Notching / birdsmouth head
addons.why: Cut seat cuts in the cell instead of on site

app: Build: roof steps flagged for fall protection (8 steps).
Scan: rafter shows pitch, seat position and which wall it bears on.
refs: BCBC 9.23.4 span tables (FRM-001: computed spans need designer check)
code: BCBC 9.23.3 to 9.23.4 joists and rafters (span tables), 9.23.9 floor joists, 9.23.13 roof framing
summary: Floor joists, rim joists, ceiling joists and rafters with birdsmouth and plumb cuts at the 30.3 degree pitch, cut to the exact model length and marked where each one bears.
highlight: 44 rafters with both plumb cuts and a burned birdsmouth line; no saw work on the roof.
routing: Acucut routing: the cell's nester groups this trade's parts by section and stock length, cuts them in bundle order (last-installed at the bottom), laser-burns the label, QR and every mark listed, and drops each bundle in its zone so the crew picks in install order.
